image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming over a textured coral reef. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins, and a prominent dorsal fin with elongated spines. The background consists of greenish-brown rocky substrate.
